title: Execute a five-value first correction with replacement noise paid
statement: Let a^2+b^2=1,0<a,b<1,eta>0,C=T G+sqrt(1-T^2)W,T density2t. Return g(bG+aH)+Z-(1/2)W_Gamma(C;Z)+eta V. Four fresh values acquire sym(K_b Dh_b),one acquires the source. This positive mean-preserving map has the full TV bound including deterministic residual, actual action variance and h_b replacement.

requires: Original whole-vector g values; Gaussian seeds and exact-real arithmetic
Raw conservative globally Lipschitz C1,1 source; no convexity, derivative or mean oracle
Fresh action seeds at the common source-correlated center; final unused reserve
For physical target sigma use tau=sigma/sqrt(1+eta^2),normalized source g/tau and lambda=L/tau,then scale output by tau
provides: At most5 original values every execution,O(d) work/storage
Covariance excess between0 and[a^2lambda^2+b^4lambda^4/4]I; separate from the law proof
assumptions: Bound becomes vacuous at fixed lambda as d grows; not a repeated quadratic step
costs: Four action values plus one source value; variance and source replacement paid
Matched ordinary5-value averaging is stronger on recorded moderate-lambda examples
Small-lambda reversal is between sufficient bounds, not optimal errors or speed
contract.units: Full marginal TV and every-execution original-value cap
contract.obstruction: No acquired reusable quadratic compiler, every-execution polylog query theorem, universal bit bound, priority or practical advantage.

evidence.quote: at most five original whole-vector g-value queries on every execution
evidence.range_scope: Actual five-value law step with source replacement and correction variance charged.

evidence.quote: two divergences separately need not be L2
evidence.range_scope: Joint-source initial inverse, joint divergence closure and L1 product boundary.

body: Closes starting-mean replacement for this first map. It does not acquire the coupled inverse or recursive law. Affine/cosine fixtures retain analytic-mean/g(0)/antithetic incumbents.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
